[[0|The full DC inverter technology lets the unit intelligently adjust the operating frequency and control the water temperature to keep the room at a constant temperature.]]
[[0|At low ambient temperatures, the REO HEATING R290 full DC inverter heat pump operates stably and efficiently]] in extremely cold regions down to -25[[1|°]]C without EVI technology. Its COP reaches up to 5.0, the energy efficiency class is A+++ (35℃) and it delivers 78[[1|°]]C hot water for the heating and cooling needs of the building. Compared with ON-OFF units and traditional electric boilers, it can achieve significant electricity savings in suitable projects (indicative).
p10_001: REO HEATING heat pumps support connection to a smart grid and a photovoltaic system to store energy. When the SG and EVU signals are connected, the heat pump runs with hot water priority to heat the water and then, depending on peak electricity consumption or other conditions, provides hot water to users. It can store energy well, monitor energy use, allocate it reasonably and reduce energy consumption.
